verdict.rationale: Isaac ROS provides ready-to-use packages for navigation/perception deployable on workstations and Jetson, and Isaac Sim supports importing robot URDF/CAD models and adding custom robots, which supports faster bring-up. However, there is no concrete evidence of an hours-not-weeks bring-up timeline, no case study of driver/config automation for new hardware, and community commentary focuses on GR00T model performance skepticism rather than hardware bring-up speed. missing for 10: quantified bring-up time evidence, first-party or independent case study of new robot onboarding, driver auto-configuration tooling specifics.
